verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye devā cutā devesu paccājāyanti;
verses.english: “… the sentient beings who die as gods and are reborn as gods are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye devā cutā niraye paccājāyanti … tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti … pettivisaye paccājāyanti.
verses.english: while those who die as gods and are reborn in hell, or the animal realm, or the ghost realm are many.”
